title: TresVista Appoints Bill Perkins as Global Head of Sales to Drive Expansion | User | theeveningleader.com
text:
TresVista Taps Bill Perkins to Spearhead Global Sales and Market Growth TresVista, a leading provider of outsourced financial solutions, has announced the appointment of Bill Perkins as Global Head of Sales. In this role, he will be responsible for leading TresVista’s global sales strategy, driving new business growth, and expanding the firm’s market presence.
Based out of TresVista’s London office, Bill brings over two decades of commercial experience in financial services. Most recently, he served as Partner & Global Head of Sales at Vanda Research, which provides tactical macro research and data to financial services firms. Prior to that, he was Head of EMEA at S3 Partners, which provides data analytics and workflow technology to the buy side. He also spent nearly two decades at Gerson Lehrman Group (GLG) as General Manager – EMEA Credit & Public Equity, where he oversaw the EMEA’s team relationships with hedge funds, mutual funds and banking relationships.
“Bill’s extensive experience in global sales leadership and his proven track record in driving revenue growth makes him an excellent fit to lead TresVista’s sales function,” said Rocco Sta. Maria, Chief Revenue Officer at TresVista. “His strategic approach and deep understanding of financial services will be instrumental in expanding our footprint and reinforcing our position as a market leader.”
At TresVista, Bill will be an integral part of the commercial leadership team, responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive global sales strategy. His key objectives will include building and managing a high-performing international sales team, driving new logo acquisition, strengthening existing revenue streams, and identifying new market opportunities. Hiring Bill complements the leadership team that TresVista has been steadily expanding over the past year as part of their long-term strategy.
“I am thrilled to join TresVista at such an exciting phase of its growth journey,” said Bill. “The firm’s commitment to delivering sophisticated solutions to its clients aligns perfectly with my experience and expertise. I look forward to working with the team to drive business expansion and to unlock new opportunities.”
